cases.sql: SELECT `id`, `email` FROM `users` WHERE `active` = ? ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM `jobs` LOCK IN SHARE MODE NOWAIT

SELECT DISTINCT `u`.`id`, LOWER(?) AS normalized FROM `users` AS `u` LEFT JOIN `profiles` AS `p` ON `p`.`user_id` = `u`.`id` OR `p`.`visible` = ? WHERE (`u`.`status` = ? OR `u`.`deleted_at` IS NULL) AND `u`.`age` BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY `u`.`id`, `u`.`email` HAVING `u`.`id` > ? OR COUNT(*) > ? ORDER BY FIELD(u.status, ?, ?) DESC LIMIT 25 OFFSET 5
DELETE FROM `users` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NOT NULL
